name: Divine Inspiration
overview: Divine Inspiration is the supernatural work of God by which He communicates His truth to humanity. Jeremiah 1:9 illustrates this as God directly places His words into the prophet's mouth, signifying the personal and authoritative nature of Scripture. John 16:13 reveals that the Spirit of truth guides believers into all truth, speaking not on His own authority but conveying what He hears from the Father. Hebrews 4:12 emphasizes the living and powerful character of God's Word, able to penetrate hearts and discern inner thoughts, demonstrating that inspired Scripture is both divinely authoritative and spiritually effective.
